+title: 'PromptInputView: slots, stock editor, EditorKit editor with slash and @file completion, attachments, submit and cancel (plan §7, §9 D)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Input/PromptInputView.swift`, `PromptEditorContext.swift`, `StockPromptEditor.swift`, `EditorKitPromptEditor.swift`, `SlashCommandSource.swift`, and `AttachmentChips.swift`, per plan.md §7 and §9 D.
+
+- `PromptInputView<Editor, Accessory>` with the constrained-extension overloads from §7. Default `Editor == StockPromptEditor` (a `TextEditor`), `Accessory == DefaultPromptAccessory`.
+- `PromptEditorContext`: `text: Binding<AttributedString>`, `placeholder`, `onSubmit`, `commands: [SlashCommand]`.
+- `EditorKitPromptEditor(context)`: hosts an EditorKit `EditorView` with `.editorSizingMode(.intrinsic)`, a `CompletionEngine` with `SlashCommandSource` (triggers on `/` at line start, completes from `context.commands`) and `PathCompletionSource` (triggers on `@`), and `SmartTag` chips for accepted `@file` references. Return sends; Shift-Return inserts a newline.
+- `AttachmentChips`: a row of `AttachmentView` chips above the editor with remove buttons; drop target for files and images; paste of an image adds a chip.
+- Submit button in `.glassProminent`; it becomes Stop while `thread.state == .running` and calls `cancel`.
+- The view calls `AgentThreadActions.send(UserInput(text:attachments:))`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `PromptInputView(text:onSubmit:)` compiles with no closures and shows the stock editor.
+- [ ] Typing `/` lists the commands from the context; accepting one inserts its name.
+- [ ] Typing `@` lists paths from the `PathCompletionSource` root; accepting one inserts a chip.
+- [ ] Return submits; Shift-Return inserts a newline.
+- [ ] While running, the button title is Stop and a tap calls `cancel`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Input/SlashCommandSourceTests.swift`: trigger detection and results.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Input/PromptInputViewHostedTests.swift`: mount both editors, drive keys, assert submit and stop through `NoopThreadActions`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
